lessons.name: segment_ctr_underperformance
lessons.description: Campaign underperforming on CTR for one segment
lessons.applies_when: A campaign's overall metrics look fine, but one specific segment (a persona, industry vertical, or lifecycle stage) has CTR well below the rest of the campaign.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply when the underperforming segment's send/render actually failed (deliverability or rendering bug) -- rule out delivery issues first.

lessons.name: seo_ranking_drop_after_migration
lessons.description: SEO ranking drop after a CMS migration
lessons.applies_when: Organic search rankings and traffic drop noticeably in the weeks following a CMS migration or site redesign.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to a gradual ranking decline unrelated in time to any migration -- that has different, usually content- or backlink-related, causes.

lessons.name: brand_voice_compliance_flag
lessons.description: Brand voice inconsistency flagged by legal/comms review
lessons.applies_when: A campaign draft comes back from legal/comms review flagged for both brand-voice inconsistency and unsupported or unverifiable claims, requiring a rewrite before it can ship.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to a voice-only flag with no claims issue, where a single pass is sufficient.

lessons.name: webinar_registration_dropoff
lessons.applies_when: A webinar has registration numbers in line with (or above) past events, but the registration-to-attendance ratio is noticeably lower than usual.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply when the drop-off is explained by a scheduling conflict with a known industry event -- that's a timing issue, not a reminder issue.

lessons.name: ab_test_inconclusive_subject_line
lessons.description: Inconclusive A/B test on subject lines
lessons.applies_when: A subject-line (or similar) A/B test finishes with no statistically significant difference between variants, and the team isn't sure whether that means 'no effect' or 'not enough data.'
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply when the test was adequately powered and still came back flat -- that is a genuine null result.

lessons.name: regulated_vertical_social_compliance
lessons.description: Social post flagged for compliance in a regulated vertical
lessons.applies_when: A social post for a regulated vertical (financial services, healthcare, insurance) is flagged by compliance, usually for a claim requiring a disclaimer or substantiation that wasn't included.
lessons.do_not_apply_when: Does not apply to posts with no substantive claim (pure brand/awareness content), which need no disclaimer at all.
